lead: A Prague group behind software and sound. G.A.W.Digital builds apps, games and the web; G.A.W.Studio records, mixes and masters. Everything we make is meant to be used, heard and played.
digital_text: Software for musicians and players: MIDI Control for Fireface, games for touch screens, and the websites around them.
studio_text: A recording studio in Prague 7. Bands, voices and podcasts recorded, mixed and mastered, in the room or online.
who_text: G.A.W.Group, s.r.o. is the company behind every G.A.W. brand. One team, one invoice, one place to start — whatever you are making next.
touch_text: Tell us what you are working on. Pick a topic and your message lands with the right people.
